scripts.check: bun run build:sdk && bun run typecheck && bun run check:protocol && bun run check:manifest && bun run test:kernel && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run build:sdk && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p sdk/typescript/tsconfig.json && tsc -p worker/bun/tsconfig.json && tsc -p worker/node/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build:sdk && bun test tests/integration.test.ts tests/protocol-contract.test.ts tests/manifest-contract.test.ts --timeout 30000 --max-concurrency 1
scripts.test:preview-node: bun run build:sdk && bun test tests/node-worker.test.ts --timeout 60000 --max-concurrency 1
scripts.test:kernel: bash -lc 'export VILANO_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"; trap "rm -rf \"$VILANO_HOME\"" EXIT; cd kernel && VILANO_KERNEL_PORT=0 VILANO_MANAGED_WORKERS=0 mix test'
scripts.pack:cli: bun run prepare:cli-package && cd cli && bun pm pack --dry-run
scripts.pack: bun run pack:sdk && bun run pack:cli
